citations.title: Robot cell fault recovery (synthetic plant SOP)
citations.text: After a robot or press fault the cell stays in stop. Only a maintenance technician holding an in-date lockout/tagout authorisation and a robot-cell entry card may lock out the cell and enter; operators and inspectors wait outside the guarding. Restart only after the technician removes their own lock.

citations.title: Robot cell entry (synthetic plant SOP)
citations.text: Enter a robot cell only after stopping the robots, locking the gate open with your own lock, and carrying an in-date robot-cell entry card. Never reach through a guard opening while the cell is in auto.

agents.name: reflex
agents.role: Geofences the incident and stops or re-routes AGVs at once (rules only, under 100 ms)

agents.name: monitor
agents.role: Classifies the alarm as real or sensor noise from thresholds and Bosch vibration evidence

agents.name: candidates
agents.role: Ranks qualified workers and healthy AGVs from the Meterless World Model (one Zetaris query)

agents.name: planner
agents.role: Nemotron (deep lane) chooses among the candidates and cites the governing clauses

agents.name: critic
agents.role: Checks the plan against OSHA-based safety rules and cites the exact clause for each violation

agents.name: dryrun
agents.role: Simulates the plan for 60 s headless (A* with a reservation table) and checks collisions and ETA

agents.name: restraint
agents.role: Decides ACT, VERIFY, SAFE_HOLD, ESCALATE or DO_NOTHING from confidence and cost
